references.text: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur is mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh, the same person who brought the offering on the eighth day.
The tribe of Manasseh and their leader Gamaliel son of Pedahzur are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement.
Gamaliel son of Pedahzur led the army of the tribe of Manasseh during the wilderness journey.
The following verses describe in detail what Gamaliel's offering consisted of on this eighth day.
Joseph named his firstborn son Manasseh, after whom the tribe is named.
Jacob adopted Manasseh as his own son, giving him the status of one of the tribes of Israel.
